review.why: Routes a full job-search agent: offer evaluation, tailored CVs, portal scans and tracking; needs its own repository.
review.summary: Router skill for a job-search agent with about 45 modes: offer evaluation, CV and cover letter generation, ATS check, portal scan, application tracker, interview prep. It only routes: the modes, scripts and AGENTS.md live in the project repository, and the skill says not to improvise them.
strengths: Very broad coverage of the job search, from offer to interview
Refuses to improvise a mode without the full repository
Treats job posting text as untrusted data
cautions: Unusable alone: needs the whole project installed (npx init or a plugin)
Dense 28,000-character router with long path-resolution rules
Large surface (portal scan, browser automation) to inspect before use
